blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–After Bryan Bagunas and other Alas Pilipinas men’s volleyball players raised concerns over a lack of support, the Philippine National Volleyball Federation took accountability, apologizing to the team and saying its new administration inherited “substantial financial liabilities.” Bagunas revealed in an interview on Sunday after the team’s opening match in the Asian Games that the players had not received adequate allowances since July, with some teammates resorting to borrowing money from others just to train and play for Alas Pilipinas. The PNVF acknowledged the concerns raised by Bagunas and apologized to the national athletes for the difficulties they have experienced. […]...
